notes: No kb/Work note owns either fix. §1985:VI.6.6.2 prints three formats: Format 1, ADD one or more identifier-1 or literal-1 TO one or more identifier-2 [ROUNDED]; Format 2, ADD one or more identifier-1 or literal-1, the optional word TO, one identifier-2 or literal-2, GIVING one or more identifier-3 [ROUNDED]; Format 3, ADD CORRESPONDING or CORR identifier-1 TO identifier-2 [ROUNDED]; each ends with the ON SIZE ERROR phrase, the NOT ON SIZE ERROR phrase and END-ADD, in that order and each optional. addStatement parses the superset and BindAdd narrows it at every edition (COBOL1689): operands with neither TO nor GIVING, a literal TO operand without GIVING (Format1Receivers), a second TO operand or a ROUNDED on it with GIVING (GivingSendingOperand); BindAddCorresponding binds Format 3. ROUNDED MODE IS is refused at 85 by VisitRoundedPhrase (COBOL0803). All probed at --std 85. Two parts of the format are NOT implemented. First, the printed sequence of the two SIZE ERROR phrases: the conditionalPhrases loop and Associates / MayAssociate have no edition arm, so NOT ON SIZE ERROR before ON SIZE ERROR compiles at 85 (the 2002 change §2002:F.2, item 33; same mechanism as the SUBTRACT, MULTIPLY, STRING and UNSTRING rows of this slice). Second, Format 2's second operand: addStatement writes addToPhrase as optional and BindAdd adds the TO operand only when it is written, so ADD A GIVING D, one operand before GIVING, compiles and stores A; the format makes only the word TO optional, and this gap has no edition arm (the 2023 Format 2 prints the same two braces). The witness runs the three formats with two or more operands and the phrases in the printed order.

next.reason: 1985: "identifier-2 [ ROUNDED ] … [ ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-1 ] [ NOT ON SIZE ERROR imperative-statement-2 ]"; 2023: "identifier-2 [ rounded-phrase ]; ROUNDED [ MODE IS {AWAY-FROM-ZERO … TRUNCATION} ]; size-error phrases in choice indicators, any order". 2023 accepts more programs: ROUNDED MODE IS options, and NOT ON SIZE ERROR may precede ON SIZE ERROR. 1985 had bare ROUNDED and a fixed phrase order.
